name: watch
description: Give an agent video context with frames, local or cloud transcription, and optional speaker diarization.

interface.shortDescription: Give an agent video context from a URL or local path.
interface.longDescription: watch downloads video, extracts frames, transcribes privately with faster-whisper or configured cloud fallbacks, and optionally labels speakers through WhisperX.
interface.developerName: Bradley Bonanno, maintained by Kevin Pacheco
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
